Dear Tom, I'm glad to receive your letter. I'm writing to tell you about the English speech contest that will be held in our school. The contest will take place in the school hall on June 15th. It will start at 2:00 pm and last for about three hours. All students who are interested in English speaking are welcome to participate. Each participant should prepare a speech of 3-5 minutes on the topic "My Dream". I sincerely invite you to join us. It will be a great opportunity for you to show your talent and make friends with other English lovers. Looking forward to your reply. Yours, Li Hua

✏ 语法错误（2 处）
"It will start at 2:00 pm" → 建议补充日期 "on June 15th at 2:00 pm"
"make friends with other English lovers" → "make friends with other English enthusiasts" 更正式
💡 用词建议
"I'm glad to receive" 可替换为 "I'm delighted to receive" 提升表达层次
"great opportunity" 可替换为 "wonderful opportunity" 或 "fantastic chance"
📝 综合评语
文章结构完整，涵盖了题目要求的三个要点。语法基础扎实，时态运用准确。建议在词汇多样性上有所提升，适当使用更高级的连接词（如 furthermore, moreover）增强逻辑衔接。书写工整，卷面整洁。

完整使用流程

从布置作业到生成报告，仅需 4 步

1. 教师发布作业
→
2. 学生提交作文
→
3. AI 自动批改
→
4. 查看数据报告
📝

Step 1: 发布作业

教师创建作文作业，设置题型（应用文/读后续写）、题目要求、评分维度权重和截止日期。

📤

Step 2: 提交作文

学生通过文本输入或上传扫描件（JPG/PNG/PDF）提交作文，系统自动 OCR 识别手写内容。

🤖

Step 3: AI 批改

系统调用 LLM 从语法、用词、构思、逻辑、书写五维度评分，生成逐句修改建议和综合评语。

📊

Step 4: 数据报告

教师查看班级成绩报告（雷达图、柱状图），学生查看个人进步趋势，支持 Excel 一键导出。

技术架构

前后端分离，工厂模式 + 策略模式实现核心模块可扩展

Vue 3 Element Plus ECharts FastAPI SQLAlchemy Pydantic DeepSeek 智谱 GLM-4V SQLite JWT
